name: Radial Chart
description: Values as arcs: concentric rings, a three-quarter gauge with the value in the middle, or a half gauge split into segments.

props.name: data
props.type: { name: string; value: number; color?: string }[]
props.description: The values. A gauge uses the first one. Colours follow the chart palette unless given.

props.name: variant
props.description: Concentric rings that sweep up to three quarters of a turn, a single three-quarter arc, or a half gauge divided into segments.

props.name: max
props.description: What a full arc stands for. Defaults to the total for stacked, 100 for a gauge and a rounded-up largest value for rings.

props.name: centerValue
props.description: Replaces the numeral in the middle: the total for stacked, the share of max for a gauge.

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Short line with the middle numeral, e.g. "of the 1,200 goal".

props.name: name
props.description: What is counted, for the rings tooltip.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in labels, the legend and the tooltip. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatScale
props.description: Writes the 0 and max labels under the ends of a gauge. Defaults to compact numbers.

props.name: size
props.description: Largest diameter in pixels: 236 for rings, 224 for a gauge, 304 for stacked. Shrinks to fit the card.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Width of each arc: 14 for rings and 18 for a gauge or stacked.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend with values under the chart. On by default for stacked; rings label themselves.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts caption, note, action, footer and every other prop of a div.
